answer:
The game is on the App side of your Spanish verbs note. It's called Verb Rush.

- **How it plays:** Each round has 10 questions. You pick the right translation from 4 choices before an 8-second bar runs out. Correct answers score more the faster you are, and a chain of correct answers multiplies the score up to x5. At the end you see which verbs to review.
- **Practice and progress:** Verbs you miss come back more often. Your best score, day streak, rounds played and verbs learned are saved in the app, and your note's text isn't changed.
- **Content:** It reads the table in your note, so any verbs you add show up in the game.
- **Settings:** In App Settings you can choose Spanish to English, English to Spanish, or mixed, and set how many questions are in a round.

`check_app` still lists two issues I left alone. One says the first control sent no edit, which is right because the Play button only starts a round. The other says a new row doesn't show in the app. A new row appears once you return to the start screen, not in the middle of a round. I haven't looked at it on a phone screen myself.
